lines.2: 「I wonder how many people are left.」
lines.3: 「Fukahire's already out. I have faith in that.」
lines.5: 「Here are the friends who have left us: Kanisawa, Fukahire, and Date.」
lines.8: 「To the roof, then. Our target is Otome.」
lines.18: 「She fled into the classroom... A rat in a trap.」
lines.21: 「I-I don't want to fight. Everyone's so bloodthirsty, it's scary...」
lines.22: 「S-so let's settle this peacefully... I'll throw my gun over there and surrender.」
lines.24: A gun came skittering out of the classroom.
lines.25: 「How spineless, throwing away your own weapon.」
lines.26: 「Very well. I'll shoot gently, so come out.」
lines.29: 「You needn't be so afraid. It's not as though I'm truly taking your life--」
lines.35: 「I-I had two guns. I picked up the one Samesuga dropped.」
lines.39: 「The roof's just ahead. Shall we storm it, Captain?」
lines.42: 「There is only one entrance. If we charge onto the roof from here, we'll be riddled with bullets.」
lines.43: 「I don't quite follow, but in that case...」
lines.45: 「Meticulous Otome will inevitably open it to investigate. The moment she does, we fire simultaneously from two angles below.」
lines.47: 「It may not be entirely fair, but neither is that woman's very existence, so I can live with it.」
lines.48: 「A rooftop is a fine sniper's nest, but once the enemy corners you there, you have nowhere to go.」
lines.49: The Princess jerked her chin, ordering me forward.
